content:
Don't want to be overshadowed by the all-new Mac mini and Mac Studio, Apple also launched an updated version of its polishing cloth today. In an era where everything is getting more expensive, the new polishing cloth is going against the grain, reduced to US$9 (down from the previous price of US$19).

It is not yet known what has changed in the new polishing cloth; Apple's product description for the new version is exactly the same as the old one:

Apple launched its polishing cloth in October 2021, and it sold out almost instantly. Although the product has already become an internet meme, it is indeed a good cloth for cleaning Apple devices.

You can order this "new" polishing cloth from Apple's official website today for US$9. When I tell you to place your order as soon as possible, I'm only half joking — but then again, maybe I'm not entirely joking either; it could sell out at any time.

If you want to keep a piece of Apple history, the original polishing cloth is still available on Amazon for US$19.
